name: Rob The Karen
desc:
Take the purse from Karen and RUN!!! The longer you survive the MORE points! 👩‍🦳💥🏏
But watch out Karen is fast!

[Update] You don't steal just the bag, but also what is inside the bag. You can find all kinds of things: sunglasses, wallet, lipstick, chewing gum, phone, and much more. If you survive the chase, you can sell the items in the newly opened Pawn Shop. Also :), if you stay up high on a house or tall building... Karen, might through rocks at you. So, if you think you are safe... 

👍LIKE THE GAME FOR UPDATE!
⭐ENJOY!!!

Made with ❤️
